info.name: Anderson Farm — Import Salary
info.description:
POST /api/v1/import/salary

Variabel (environment atau collection):
- `baseUrl` — contoh: http://localhost:8000
- `bearerToken` — Bearer token dari login (role Finance atau Admin)

Body: multipart/form-data, field `file` = Excel template gaji (.xlsx).

Import: pilih **Merge** jika collection Anderson Farm API sudah ada.

formdata.description: Excel template gaji (xlsx/xls/csv, max 5MB). Kolom wajib: Period Code, Employee Username, Total Gaji.

request.description:
Import data gaji ABK dari Excel (all-or-nothing).

**Validasi file:** `file` wajib, mimes xlsx/xls/csv, max 5120 KB.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{bearerToken}}`. Hanya **finance** atau **admin**.

**Sukses (200):** `{ success: true, message: "...", data: null }` — upsert `EmployeeSalary` (payment_status `paid`) + `Transaction` jurnal.

**Gagal isi file (422):** `{ success: false, message: "...", data: { errors: ["Baris N: ...", ...] } }` — tidak ada perubahan DB.

**Error lain:** 401 guest, 403 role tidak diizinkan, 422 validasi Form Request (file kosong/mime salah).
